This document out outlines 
 the minor maintenance procedure as indicated by P1 in the above title 
 block for the manual 
 gate valve depending on external / internal leakage

This valve to be used to sense of flow of working liquid. The 
 welded valves used at high pressure lines

The first 
 draft initiated and tested by eng. Fawzy Ahmed Basuoni at 27 Dec 2003, 
 accepted by General Director eng. Saad Mostafa, revised by EDEPC eng. Samir 
 Abdel-Gelil, and approved by eng. Awad Mohammed Fathy Soliman Head 
 Sector of Talkha power station.

Work order 
 must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area.
Wear safety Helmet, belt, shoes, .... etc

Drain the pipeline, which connected to this 
 valve.

sections.text:
Check any leakage from valve gland. If it 
 found, retighten on gland bolts.

Check any leakage from the valve bodies (cracks or mechanical 
 wear). Remark the point of leakage.

Be sure the valve was out of operation and the 
 pressure inside the pipeline connected to the valve must be zero from the two

Be sure the pipeline is drained.

items: Be sure the pipeline is drained.
Screw off nut (5) of gland bolt (6).
Take up the gland follower (7).
Screw off yoke (2) around valve body (1).

Take out from hand wheel (11) all parts of the 
 valve except body.
Take out cone (3) from spindle (4).

Screw off nut (10) and take out hand wheel 
 (11)

Turn the yoke (2) around spindle (4) until the 
 yoke take out from spindle (4).
Screws off the retaining screw (12).
Take out yoke sleeve (9) from yoke (2).
Take out the gland follower (12).
Take out the gland packing (8), ring (13).

If 
 the valve damaged, change it w.r.t. the material as stated in table 1

items:
Check the valves cone (3) and regrind the 
 sealing surface of it if needed.

Check the valves seat and regrind it if 
 needed.

Repair the valve cone (3) and valve seat in a 
 specialist workshop if grinding can not repair the wear in there. ( in weld 
 type the valve end must be cut from the pipe line)

Check the Spindle (4) and repair it if needed 
 or replace it.

Check the yoke sleeve (9) and repair it if 
 needed or replace it.

Checks ring (13) and repair it if needed or 
 replace it.

Check the Gland follower (7) and repair it if 
 needed or replace it.
Clean every connection face.

Check the body (1) from any cracks or wear by 
 using penetration fluids and repair it if found by using suitable filler 
 material or its equivalent acc. to table (1).

If 
 the valve damaged, change it w.r.t. the material as stated in table 1

Assembly the valve parts in reverse sequence of 
 disassembly.

sections.text: Replace the Packing of Valve Gland

items:
Clean the stuffing box chamber and the cover 
 well.
Lubricate the gland bolts and nuts.
Use suitable size of packing.

Wire the suitable packing size on a part of 
 shaft with the same diameter of valve spindle.

Cut all packing rings along the shaft by using 
 sharp knife.

Fit the rings in the stuffing box chamber with 
 the cut turned 180 , starting at 9 clock.
Tighten the gland bolts.

Open and close the valve and be sure that the 
 valve operation is correct.
